title: 🚀 Welcome to KeepAI — Your AI Second Brain
content:
KeepAI is a full-stack workspace combining Google Keep's intuitive design with Google Gemini AI.

Key Backend & AI Capabilities:
• ⚡ Dedicated Node.js & Express REST API
• 🛡️ Secure Server-Side Gemini AI proxying
• 📋 Automatic To-Do Checklist Extractor
• 🎯 Career Hub: Job Description to Interview Cheat Sheet
• 🎙️ Speech-to-Text Voice Dictation
• 💾 Persistent Database storage + JSON backups

title: 🎯 Senior Full-Stack Engineer: Interview Prep
content:
Core Competencies to Highlight:
1. Architecture: Vite + React 18 frontend, Node.js + Express backend, REST APIs.
2. AI Integration: Server-side Gemini API calls, structured JSON outputs, streaming tokens, robust offline fallbacks.
3. STAR Story (High Scale Refactor):
• Situation: Monolithic frontend had performance bottlenecks and exposed API keys.
• Task: Architect a decoupled, full-stack system with secure backend AI proxies and sub-second HMR.
• Action: Migrated to Vite 5, implemented Express REST API, added responsive CSS Grid masonry, built offline fallbacks.
• Result: 10x faster build times, zero security vulnerabilities, and positive stakeholder reviews.
